motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Eagle Mountain City Fiscal Year 2019-2020Budget. **This is not an action item, public hearing only*x Assistant City Administrator Paul Jerome said the budget has not changed from previous years Board Chair Westmoreland opened the public hearing at 9:31 p.m. As there were no comments, he closed the hearing. 4. ADJOURNMENT
motions.motion: Board Member Gricius moved to approve the May 7, 2019 Redevelopment Agency Board meeting minutes. Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clark. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: May 7 minutes approved
motions.summary: The agency board approved the minutes of its May 7 meeting; a hearing on the 2019-2020 city budget drew no comment and no vote.
motions.impact: Record-keeping for the agency's files, and nothing more. The budget item that night was listening time only, so no money moved and no rate changed.

motions.impact: Adjournment is the clock stopping, not a decision. Nothing about it reaches a resident.
